annotations.title: Most walkable neighborhoods in a city

description:
Neighborhoods inside a US city, ranked most walkable first, precomputed.

Use this for "which part of Chicago should I live in without a car". Returns up to 25 neighborhoods, each with its 0-10 score, tier and components. Covers 749 neighborhoods across the cities analysed so far, so an empty list means that city has not been broken down yet, not that it has no walkable areas.
name: find_walkable_neighborhoods
